# CreateDir <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
CreateDir:Void dir:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | In | String | required | The folder to create. |

## Description

Creates a folder. Nothing happens when it already exists.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
CreateDir "files_create_example"
Print FileType("files_create_example")
DeleteDir "files_create_example"
```

```text
2
```
